neighbours.label: a lone v / w / d letter token that starts an English or Latin word the tokenizer splits, typically right after '(' , a quote or a hyphen ((w|heat, 'v|ibrissae', half-w|it, V|ertebrata)
fire: Lampreys are placed in the same group (subphylum Vertebrata) as the bony fishes.
The stall sold candles made of cheap materials (wax, tallow and string).
Small garden birds (wrens, tits and sparrows) nest in the hedge every year.
She seasoned the fish with fresh herbs (dill, parsley and chives) and butter.
The crowd blew a plastic horn, the 'vuvuzela', throughout the match.
Only a nit-wit would leave the keys in the car overnight.
The carpenter split the log with simple tools (wedges, a maul and an axe).
At the centre of the drain a small 'vortex' formed as the water ran out.
quiet: Lampreys are placed in the same group as the bony fishes by most authors.
The stall sold candles made of cheap materials such as tallow and string.
Small garden birds nest in the hedge every year and sing at dawn.
She seasoned the fish with fresh herbs (parsley, chives and thyme) and butter.
The crowd blew a plastic horn, the 'trumpet', throughout the match.
Only a fool would leave the keys in the car overnight.
The carpenter split the log with simple tools (hammers, a saw and an axe).
At the centre of the drain a small 'whirlpool' formed as the water ran out.

notes: Token splits checked with the tokenizer only (no scoring). The - pole's top examples are the same letters starting Spanish/German words (' v|iven', ' W|iedau'); a Spanish probe did not fire the + pole. ' f|eng' probed weak (0.11), so f is left out of the test.
